set.body: Carry verified native plan, admitted-input and completed-result identities into saved Studio projects through actual execution and persistence. Preserve semantic source identity vs canonical input digest and result digest vs archive-index hash, exact run/revision/dataset ownership, terminal/cancellation ordering, old schema pins and truthful storage failures. Qualify native command and desktop save/reopen/export routes. Bounded artifact-delivery slice; broader G1/S3.7 and hosted acceptance remain open.
set.title: S3.7 verified native artifact binding delivery
